# orion note

Notes for context, decisions, and reminders

```sh
orion note <command> [options]
```

## orion note add

Add a note, optionally between two linked items

```sh
orion note add [options] [text...]
```

| Argument           | Description                        |
| ------------------ | ---------------------------------- |
| `[text...]`        | Note text                          |
| `--group <value>`  | Group to add it to, by id or label |
| `--after <value>`  | Item the note follows              |
| `--before <value>` | Item the note leads into           |
| `--json`           | Print JSON                         |
